CIV.note: Nothing on AI rules or an authority.
Training of civil servants on AI is a course, not a system in use.

facts.fact: Xinhua reports that Cote d'Ivoire's digital transition ministry signed three memoranda with the private sector on 19 May 2025 to speed implementation of the existing National AI Strategy (SNIA).

systems.owner: Ministere de la Transition numerique et de la Digitalisation

CIV.note: The memoranda are not stated to carry public money; the ministry is not named as the strategy's executing body.
No AI model, dataset or computing stated.
Digital sovereignty appears only as an aim of the memoranda; no policy, rule or hosting stated.
